purpose: Correct the transfer-partition boundary before any provider call while inheriting the v2 arms, metrics, scenario population, model plan, semantic validator, budget contract and ten evaluation questions unchanged.

base_protocol.inheritance: All v2 provisions remain binding except scenario_population.transfer_partitions, scenario_population.partition_invariants and their transfer-boundary interpretation, which this document replaces.

v2_transfer_disposition.reason: The v2 diagnostic joined lifecycle events transitively through shared actors and objects. Common institutional operators therefore connected all 500 scenarios into one component, which cannot fit a maximum partition capacity of 350.
v2_transfer_disposition.interpretation: This is a specification defect, not negative evidence about KG value and not a runtime failure. No v2 result may be reported.

transfer_partition_contract.assignment_unit: An indivisible focal business-root closure component. The component contains the focal root, focal-root lifecycle events, focal source records, focal exact/near-duplicate derivatives, explicit focal message threads and the scenario family.

focal_boundary.focal_business_root: The typed trade, case, client, person or truth-atom subject named by the scenario cluster.
focal_boundary.event_chain: All lifecycle events whose subject is the focal business root. Shared actors and related objects are provenance context and never connect unrelated roots.
focal_boundary.held_out_identity: The client entity, product entity, complete focal employee reporting lineage, or scenario-family cluster selected by the assigned transfer dimension.
focal_boundary.permitted_shared_context: Institution, venue, system, shared operator, related object and non-selected identity context may recur. It cannot be promoted into the held-out focal identity or used to derive its answer.
focal_boundary.provider_state: Every call is isolated. Provider conversations, caches containing request content and model-visible state may not carry evidence or answers between scenarios.

holdout_semantics.unseen_clients: Requires a resolved canonical client identity cluster and its full alias closure for the focal trade/case/client question.
holdout_semantics.unseen_products: Requires a resolved canonical product entity identity and its full alias closure; a trade-product linkage or product text label is not a substitute.
holdout_semantics.unseen_staff_hierarchies: Requires the complete reports_to lineage from the focal employee or case assignee to its reporting root, including every lineage identity alias closure.
holdout_semantics.unseen_scenario_families: Requires the committed latent scenario-family cluster, never a generated question-string hash.
holdout_semantics.sealed_iid: Contains no selected transfer identity and receives only components not assigned to another exact target.

closure_invariants: No focal business root crosses transfer partitions.
No focal source record crosses transfer partitions.
No focal exact-duplicate or near-duplicate cluster crosses transfer partitions.
No explicit focal message-thread cluster crosses transfer partitions.
No scenario-family cluster crosses transfer partitions.
Every non-IID assignment has a typed focal identity of the assigned dimension.
Alias closure is resolved from the content-addressed world entity catalogue for the focal root and selected held-out identity.
Source-reference truth atoms and artifact IDs must exactly match the content-addressed provenance span.
Subject-line similarity, question wording, generator knowledge and caller-authored empty arrays cannot establish message-thread closure.

preexecution_assessment.consequence: The exact split is now structurally feasible, but no smoke or target provider call may begin until explicit message-thread metadata is generated, content-addressed and the catalogue and assignment are rebuilt.

additional_preexecution_commitments.binding_rule: All additional commitments and v2 commitments must be present in one immutable signed preexecution manifest before the first smoke-prefix call. A provisional or incomplete partition manifest is not bindable.

analysis_lock.protocol_change_rule: Any further material change requires preregistration v4 with a new canonical self digest before execution.

self_digest_algorithm: sha256(canonical-json(document-without-self_sha256); UTF-8; keys sorted; separators comma+colon; ensure_ascii=false)
